about: The world lane's fixed questions for the parts library (P0): new levels in a brief's words, written before any method was run on them. Every method's top answers are pooled and labelled blind by two labellers (labels.json); `kit parts world eval` scores each method on them. Add a question only from real work, never to suit a method.

questions.brief: harbour dock: wooden piers on posts over the water, a stone quay wall with stairs down to the water, crates and barrels scattered, a lighthouse at the end
castle courtyard: high stone walls with battlements, a gatehouse arch, a well in the middle, stairs up to the wall walk, spawn points at both gates
forest clearing arena: a round open clearing ringed by dense trees, rocks for cover, a path in from two sides, fair spawns opposite each other
tavern interior: a long bar counter, tables and benches, a hearth on one wall, stairs to the rooms above, a cellar door
mountain pass: a narrow trail winding up between cliffs, a rope bridge over a chasm, a waterfall, a shrine at the top
market square: a paved plaza with stalls under awnings, a fountain, townhouses around it, alleys leading out
ruined temple: broken columns, a collapsed roof, a raised altar platform up a flight of steps, overgrown with vines and grass
rooftop parkour course: rooftops at different heights, gaps to jump, ledges and ladders, a route an R6 player can always reach
desert oasis: dunes around a pool of water, palm trees, a stone ruin half buried in the sand, rocks for shade
training yard: a fenced dirt yard with target dummies, an archery range lane, weapon racks, a small hut
